## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and its behavior is described above.
- [ ] I tested the change, or explained why testing was not applicable.
- [ ] Documentation is updated if needed.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, service-role keys, or other secrets.
- [ ] Database or permission changes include migration and security impact details.
